beats.summary: Dwight reveals a daycare center in his building and gives Jim and Pam a tour.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Why didn't I think of this before? Did you know that there is a daycare center opening right here in this building?
Dwight: Welcome to the Sesame Avenue Daycare Center for infants and toddlers.

beats.summary: Jim tests the daycare center door lock by closing it and trying to get out, challenging Dwight's claim.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Were going to head outside, give it a whirl. I just want to see how it works.
Dwight: I promise you, that door locks!

beats.summary: Dwight calls for a boycott of the Steamtown Mall and cancels Andy's clients there using offensive language.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Boycott the Steamtown Mall! Everyone, you heard me! Cancel all of your business with the Steamtown Mall!
Andy: Did you call all of my clients at the mall and cancel all my business while using the "F" word?

beats.summary: Dwight explains he was snubbed at a fancy store in the mall, which motivated his boycott.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I went to the store and I pressed the buzzer, and they looked right at me, and then they looked away.

beats.summary: Jim suggests teaming up with Dwight to confront the snobby store owners instead of boycotting.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Dwight, how about this? Instead of boycotting, you and I, together, go down to that store and we teach those snobs a lesson.

beats.summary: Michael resists counseling with Toby, showing anger and reluctance to participate.

evidence.snippet: Michael: This is the worst! You are the worst! I hate looking at your face! I wanna smash it!
Michael: One hour. We've done one hour. Let's just speed this up, ok? Keep it moving.
